description: As a forensic analyst, the carver falls back to aggressive record scanning on corrupt chunks so I can recover events even when the chunk header is unusable
steps: carve_from_bytes on a chunk whose header_checksum is wrong but contains valid record magic bytes returns records marked Integrity::Carved
carve_from_bytes aggressive scan finds records that do not start at the expected sequential position in the records area
records recovered via aggressive scan have valid record_id and timestamp fields parsed from the record header
CarveStats.records_corrupt is incremented for records found via aggressive scan
aggressive scan does not duplicate records already found by sequential walk
